messages:
deploy-bot: Tagged deploy started: v1.8.2-hotfix-2026-03-20 -> env=prod-eu1, from=staging, commit=9f4c2b1 (short), pipeline=#deploy-hotpatch

olivia: Thanks — any notes on the exact change set? Link to changelog?

deploy-bot: Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v1.8.2-hotfix-2026-03-20 (summary: fix embedding alignment bug, reduce memory spike on long-context requests). CI: green. Canary target: 5% traffic to canary pool cp-eu1-canary. :rocket:

raj: Noted. I'm watching canary performance dashboards. Putting a pin on full promote until we confirm latency/99% under 120ms for 15m.

marco: Copy. SRE, can you confirm no error-rate spike in the first 5 minutes?

sre-oncall: Observing canary tail latency up ~18% vs baseline at t+2m, p99 moved from 110ms -> 135ms. No errors yet. CPU on canary GPU nodes trending +12%. Investigating batch sizing. :mag:

qa-bot: Automated smoke tests: 12/12 passing against canary endpoints. Regression test suite (long-context) running, ETA ~8m.

olivia: If p99 stays >120ms after 10m we should consider pinning 0.5 and rolling back the tag. We don't want downstream SLAs impacted.

raj: Agreed. Also add a temporary routing policy to shift new sessions to stable model variant (v1.8.1) while we triage. Can someone update routing?

marco: I can flip routing. Command: 
```
# shift 90% traffic to v1.8.1 variant for prod-eu1
infractl routing update --env prod-eu1 --from v1.8.2-hotfix --to v1.8.1 --weight 0.9
```

marco: Doing it now.

deploy-bot: Routing update applied: v1.8.1=90%, v1.8.2-hotfix=10% in prod-eu1.

sre-oncall: After routing shift, p99 on canary pool reduced to 118ms at t+9m. CPU normalized. Looks like increased load on new kernel path caused short spike when at full traffic.

raj: Good catch. Can we promote but keep conservative routing (10% canary) and schedule a quick hotfix follow-up for kernel batching tweak?

olivia: Yes, promote to 30% but keep automated rollback policy for 30m if p99 >130ms.

marco: Promote command: 
```
deploybot promote --tag v1.8.2-hotfix-2026-03-20 --env prod-eu1 --target 30% --canary 30m --auto-rollback-p99 130
```

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated: tag=v1.8.2-hotfix-2026-03-20, target=30%, window=30m. :eyes:

qa-bot: Running smoke checks at 30% routing. All critical paths passing.

sre-oncall: Monitoring. No errors, p99 steady ~120ms. Will notify if crossing threshold.

olivia: Document follow-up ticket for batching kernel tweak and coord with runtime team. I'll create an action item.

olivia: Created ticket INF-1421: 'Investigate batching kernel path p99 spike on v1.8.2-hotfix' and assigned to @raj, due EOD. Link: https://internal.redwood/issue/INF-1421

raj: Acknowledged. Will look into perf traces and KV cache behavior.

deploy-bot: Promotion progress: 30% target reached at t+18m. No auto-rollback triggered. :white_check_mark:

marco: Thanks all. I'll keep an eye on the routing window until we hit full promote. If metrics stable at end of window, we'll promote to 100% with usual cadence.

olivia: Marking release notes with 'promoted to 30% prod-eu1; monitoring window active'. Will update if we go to 100%. :memo:
